channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kyle Kuzma | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kyle Kuzma from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Myles Turner on Kyle Kuzma, Ousmane Dieng, Jericho Sims
item.description:
Turner said after shootaround on Tuesday.

“Some days, I’ll play 22 (minutes). Some days, it’s 28. I think everybody in the organization is trying to figure it out — just different lineups, different combination of guys. “At times, we like to go with switching lineups, so they put Jericho (Sims) or Ous (Ousmane Dieng) or Kuz (Kyle Kuzma), one of those guys at my position. But all I can do is go out there, just stay consistent, put my work in every single day, just to be available and be healthy. And whatever’s asked of me to do, just go out there and do.”

Myles Turner on Kyle Kuzma, Ousmane Dieng, Jericho Sims, Mar 11, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Jay King:Kristaps Porzingis on Kyle Kuzma guarding him:

“I don’t think he realized last year what I was doing for them. All the tricks, all the drawing of fouls, a little bit of grab here and there.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Kyle Kuzma, Feb 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Spencer Dinwiddie on Kyle Kuzma:

“At the end of the day, I spoke truth and I got rebutted with 10 year old insults.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Kyle Kuzma, Apr 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Mike Trudell:LeBron on @Kyle Kuzma:

“We matched up a lot tonight … seeing my 2 brothers, KCP and Kuz, seeing Kuz development this year has been so amazing. His playmaking, shotmaking… it’s always a welcoming feeling when you see (a championship) teammate you was in the foxhole with.”

LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma, Mar 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, 2020 Lakers champions who return tonight with the Wizards:

“Nothing but love for those guys … they’ll always be family … it was very hard to see them go, but that’s the nature of this business.”

Frank Vogel on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Kyle Kuzma, Mar 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rui Hachimura on Russell Westbrook, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Quinton Mayo:Rui Hachimura on style inspiration:

“When I got drafted into the league, seeing Russell Westbrook and his style—he’s one of the best guys in the league for fashion. This year we have Kyle Kuzma and he's very unique too. It’s fun and feels good to have a nice outfit on.”

Rui Hachimura on Russell Westbrook, Kyle Kuzma, Jan 31, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealQuintonMayo.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma:

“His role on this team is to be a secondary scoring option. ... There is a mindset is to get him involved some.... If he defends and rebounds, he's helping us win.”

Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma, May 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma:

“There's no doubt that he's taken another step. ... Someone that can impact the game in more ways than scoring.”

Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma, Feb 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma:

“Kuz is an extremely versatile player. That's what we love about him.... the versatility he brings to the table has been invaluable for us so far.”

Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma, Jan 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Avery Bradley, on Lakers' ring ceremony,

“I'm really intrigued. I will watch it tonight. I actually was texting Kyle Kuzma this morning.”

Avery Bradley on Kyle Kuzma, Dec 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma:

“I personally couldn't be more excited that we got Kuz into a contract extension. He'll be with us for years to come and I just love what the young man represents... He's the kind of player that we want here with LA Lakers on the floor.”

Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma, Dec 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
LeBron on Kyle Kuzma, who he said practiced today:

“He looks like Kuz, but it’s going to take him a little bit of time to get into game shape ... (there’s no substitute for playing actual NBA games)... it’s great to have him back on the floor, we definitely missed him.”

LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma, Oct 31, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Jared Dudley asked about leadership:

“My guy would be Kyle Kuzma. What can I do off the court to help him get to his full potential? He’s really the key for us.”

Jared Dudley on Kyle Kuzma, Sep 27, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Brandon Ingram, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
“LeBron and Rondo are arguably two of the best leaders ever. Having both of them out, that's two of our main guys who are talking on the court. It's new for me. It's new for BI [Brandon Ingram]. Kuz [Kyle Kuzma] probably talks the most out of all of us.”

Lonzo Ball on Brandon Ingram, Kyle Kuzma, Jan 14, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
“That really don't matter to me. That is the team he is on and that is who we face. It obviously is going to be a tough challenge, they are playing well. They got a lot of guys playing well. Kuz [Kyle Kuzma] has really stepped up his game, Lonzo [Ball] is playing well.”

Draymond Green on Kyle Kuzma, Dec 24, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Brandon Ingram, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
“I think we got proven scorers — Kyle Kuzma, Brandon Ingram … and then when you have two point guards like Ball and Rondo, we don’t have to have LeBron having the ball in his hands all the time.”

Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Brandon Ingram, Kyle Kuzma, Dec 5, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Johnson told SiriusXM NBA Radio.

“We got a lot of ballhandlers so we feel we won't overuse him in terms of his ballhandling and also every play has to run through him. I think we got proven scorers -- Kyle Kuzma, Brandon Ingram ... and then when you have two point guards like Ball and Rondo, we don't have to have LeBron having the ball in his hands all the time.”

Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma, Nov 29, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Brandon Ingram:

“I think our youth has to be better in situations like that when we go out and just try to be in open areas, and we have been good. I think Lonzo has been good. Kuzma has been good. I think we can just do it more and more when we get in those situations.”

Brandon Ingram on Kyle Kuzma, Nov 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma's performance:

“Spectacular. He was great. Made big shots. Made big plays. Kept us in the game when we was down. He did a little bit of everything.”

LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma, Oct 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
LeBron on Kuzma:

“He just wants to get better. He wants to be one of the best players in the league … you always respect that.”

LeBron James on Kyle Kuzma, Sep 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Lonzo Ball on Kyle Kuzma:

“As you could see Kuz's body is a lot bigger and his shot is looking a lot better.”

Lonzo Ball on Kyle Kuzma, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Magic Johnson, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Michael Cooper on Lonzo Ball & Kyle Kuzma:

“Lonzo Ball has shown that he’s kind of like a Magic Johnson-type of player. He’s the type of player that makes other players around him better. I think Kyle Kuzma has shown that he can shoot the ball with some of the best.”

Michael Cooper on Magic Johnson, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma, Aug 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Brandon Ingram, Josh Hart, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Jeanie Buss:

“Drafting players like Kyle Kuzma and Josh Hart and Lonzo Ball and the continued development of Brandon Ingram, you can see what Laker basketball stands for.”

Jeanie Buss on Brandon Ingram, Josh Hart, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma, Aug 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Josh Hart, Kyle Kuzma, Moritz Wagner
item.description:
He not only caught the eye of president of basketball operations Magic Johnson and general manager Rob Pelinka, but Josh Hart and Kyle Kuzma as well.

“Kyle Kuzma and Josh Hart were actually at Moe Wagner’s workout, and both of them were elbowing Earvin and I, saying, ‘Man, this guy would be fun to play with. He plays with energy, he’s light on his feet,'”

Rob Pelinka on Josh Hart, Kyle Kuzma, Moritz Wagner, Jun 23, 2018. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Carlos Boozer on @Kyle Kuzma:

“This kid is clutch. He’s gotten better & better. He’s a triple-threat guy. Knockdown a 3. He can drive to the hoop. He can play make for his teammates. Makes big plays. Has multiple 30-pt games. That kid right there is a future star.”

Carlos Boozer on Kyle Kuzma, Apr 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Isaiah Thomas, Julius Randle, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Luke Walton:

“A lot of that's not going to be answered until they get here and we see them play and what they can do and who they can work well with. And even that takes time. Maybe Isaiah and Julius [Randle] develop a great two-way game or [Kyle] Kuzma–- you just never know. So I'm not going to spend my time too focused on that right now as opposed to getting ready for OKC.”

Luke Walton on Isaiah Thomas, Julius Randle, Kyle Kuzma, Feb 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Tom Thibodeau on Kyle Kuzma:

“His skill set fits today’s NBA perfectly. The way he’s shooting the ball sets up the rest of his game. Terrific talent.”

Tom Thibodeau on Kyle Kuzma, Dec 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.
